summary.en: The trace look: a flat dark diagram where a run draws the picture, four semantic colours with one meaning each, a serif for the author, a mono for the run, a sans for the narration.
summary.zh: trace 的样式：平涂深底的图解，画面由运行结果画出；四种语义色各只有一个含义，衬线体讲观点，等宽体给运行数据，无衬线体讲解。

fits: Explainers of a mechanism that runs on a tiny input: tokenising, compressing, sorting, counting; any proof by a run.
notFor: Launch films; claims with no mechanism; anything that needs photographs or a brand colour.

intent.en: A mechanism is believed because it is seen running: the picture is the run's state, with four colours that each mean one thing.
intent.zh: 机制被相信，是因为看见它在跑：画面就是运行状态，四种颜色各只表示一件事。

content.en: A small input the mechanism really runs on (four to six rows); captions and a thesis.
content.zh: 机制真能跑的小输入（四到六行）；说明和结论。

fits.zh: 在小输入上运行的机制讲解：分词、压缩、排序、计数；任何用一次运行来证明的东西。

notFor.zh: 发布片；没有机制的主张；需要照片或品牌色的片。

en: Every colour has one meaning; using the accent for emphasis breaks the legend.
Source Serif 4 and Noto Serif SC are not in tools/fonts.json: samples show the sans instead of the serif.
zh: 每种颜色只有一个意思；拿强调色做强调会打破图例。
Source Serif 4 与 Noto Serif SC 不在 tools/fonts.json，小样里衬线体显示为无衬线体。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
